name: Urea cycle arginine synthesis and ornithine transcarbamylase deficiency
rationale: All members concern citrulline/arginine synthesis in the urea cycle; the OTC deficiency variants separate it from neighbours covering other urea-cycle enzyme defects or ornithine/ammonium handling.

core: Vitamin K, C and E metabolism and response
name: Vitamin K-dependent carboxylation and vitamin C metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors, vitamin C metabolism/transport and vitamin E response; the ascorbate arm separates it from vitamin D/E/ubiquinone neighbours and the vitamin K carboxylation arm from the oxygen-transport neighbour.

name: Proline and glutamine-family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members are general L-/alpha-amino acid metabolic terms anchored by proline synthesis and catabolism and glutamine-family metabolism, which distinguish it from glycine/serine/glyoxylate and organic-acid neighbours.

qualifier: RHOA subfamily, CDC42 and formin activation
name: RHOA-subfamily and CDC42 GTPase cycles with formin activation
rationale: All members are Rho-family small GTPase signalling; RHOA/B/C, RHOG/RHOD and formin activation distinguish it from neighbours built on RAC, IQGAP, ROCK/PAK or RND GTPases.

name: Antimicrobial protein killing of fungi and Gram-positive bacteria
rationale: Members describe host killing and cytolysis of microbes, antifungal and anti-Gram-positive defence and nutritional metal sequestration, separating it from neighbours on respiratory burst, Gram-negative killing, mucosal agglutination or neutrophil degranulation.

qualifier: COPI retrograde transport and Rab GTPase regulation
name: COPI Golgi traffic, Golgi organization and Rab GTPase regulation
rationale: Members cover COPI/intra-Golgi and Golgi-to-ER traffic, Golgi assembly and positioning, and Rab/Arf GTPase control; COPI traffic and Rab GEF/GAP/prenylation separate it from TGN-to-endosome/lysosome, COPII or Ral neighbours.

qualifier: cation-chloride cotransport and epithelial chloride/potassium transport
name: Cation-chloride cotransport in osmotic and epithelial salt homeostasis
rationale: Members cover Na/K/Cl transport (SLC12 cotransporter diseases, K channels, renal sodium transport) and cellular osmotic responses; Ca-activated K channels, SLC26A3 chloride secretion and paracellular transport separate it from Na/H exchanger, K2P, P-type ATPase and tight-junction neighbours.

name: MECP2-HDAC corepressor regulation of neuronal genes and sensory behavior
rationale: Most members are MECP2 transcriptional regulation and Rett loss-of-function events, joined by sensory/visual behaviours; HDAC/NCoR corepression and translation/calcium-channel restraint distinguish it from MECP2 neighbours rich in locomotor and vocal behaviours.

name: Nucleotide phosphotransfer, phosphocreatine and NAD(P) metabolism
rationale: Members interconvert nucleoside mono/di/triphosphates, move ADP/ATP and NAD across mitochondria, and handle creatine and nicotinate/NAD(P); the NAD(P) arm and creatine/mitochondrial ADP-ATP arm each separate it from neighbours.

name: Transcriptional control of erythroid differentiation
rationale: Members are erythroid differentiation terms and expression modules of erythroid commitment and maturation with transcription-regulatory cores (TAL1-GFI1B, ATF); this distinguishes it from megakaryocyte, haematopoietic stem cell and primitive/definitive erythropoiesis neighbours.

name: RNA polymerase II transcription regulation through termination and R-loops
rationale: Members regulate Pol II preinitiation, elongation and poly(A)-coupled termination plus R-loop processing and chromatin access; termination and R-loop terms separate it from elongation-complex, Pol I/III and MYC-target neighbours.

name: B cell receptor signalling and B cell development
rationale: Members cover BCR signalling, B cell proliferation, differentiation, homeostasis and germinal centres; proximal BCR signalling (BTK, RAS, CD22, second messengers) distinguishes it from plasma-cell, T-cell and B-cell surface-signature neighbours.

qualifier: against recombination and non-homologous end joining
name: Telomere end protection against recombination and end joining
rationale: All members concern capping and packaging telomere ends, blocking recombination/NHEJ and limiting telomerase; this separates it from C-strand synthesis, D-loop/t-circle and telomerase-extension neighbours.

core: Post-transcriptional mRNA stability and translation control
qualifier: stress granules and stabilizing RNA-binding proteins
name: Stress granules and mRNA stabilization by RNA-binding proteins
rationale: Members cover stress granule assembly/disassembly, PKR/arsenite stress and RNA-binding proteins (HuR, IGF2BPs, AUF1) controlling mRNA stability and translation; stress-granule and stabilizing terms separate it from TTP/BRF1/KSRP decay and decapping neighbours.

name: Canonical Wnt signalling via AXIN stability and destruction complex
rationale: Members concern beta-catenin/TCF signalling and the AXIN-APC destruction complex; AXIN degradation and stabilization distinguish it from neighbours on DVL, FZD regulation and target-gene repression.

qualifier: KATP channel and incretin control of insulin
name: Beta cell insulin secretion via KATP channels and incretins
rationale: Members regulate insulin production, secretion and clearance by beta cells (KATP channels, incretins, FFAR1, glucokinase, autonomic input); KATP channels and beta-cell survival separate it from insulin-receptor signalling and GLUT4 neighbours.

qualifier: VEGF/Tie angiogenesis and smooth muscle phenotypic switching
name: VEGF/Tie angiogenesis and vascular smooth muscle phenotypic regulation
rationale: Members regulate endothelial angiogenesis via VEGF and Tie2 and vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration and differentiation; VEGF/Tie terms separate it from leukocyte-adhesion and aortic neighbours, smooth-muscle terms from the endothelial-only neighbour.

name: Planar cell polarity-driven convergent extension in embryonic morphogenesis
rationale: All members concern PCP signalling and convergent extension of embryonic tissues; convergent extension and neural plate morphogenesis distinguish it from axial mesoderm, notochord and non-canonical Wnt internalization neighbours.

qualifier: T and B cell, costimulation and coinhibition
name: T and B cell receptor signalling, costimulation and coinhibition
rationale: Members cover proximal TCR and BCR signalling with CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA coinhibition; inclusion of BCR signalling and PECAM1 separates it from T-cell-only neighbours.

name: Neutral and acidic amino acid transport across plasma membrane
rationale: Members are amino acid transmembrane transport and transporter disorders (SLC6A19 Hartnup, SLC1A1 aminoaciduria, SLC6A14); acidic SLC1A1 and SLC6A14 terms distinguish it from imino/glycine, peptide and cystinuria neighbours.

qualifier: sarcoplasmic reticulum uptake and sodium-calcium exchange
name: Cytosolic calcium clearance and sarcoplasmic reticulum store regulation
rationale: Members lower cytosolic calcium via SR/ER uptake (SERCA regulation), Na/Ca exchange and restraint of RyR release; caffeine response and SERCA/exchanger terms separate it from cardiac-contraction and release-promoting neighbours.

qualifier: base excision repair and direct alkylation reversal
name: Base excision repair and direct alkylation damage reversal
rationale: Members cover glycosylase defects, AP-site processing and long-patch BER plus MGMT/ALKBH alkylation reversal; alkylation reversal and long-patch steps separate it from neighbours on glycosylase recognition, mismatch repair and interstrand cross-links.

name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signalling, its cancer mutants and RUNX3
rationale: Members span TGF-beta, BMP, activin and AMH receptor-SMAD signalling and its regulation; cancer receptor/SMAD mutants, TGFBR3 and RUNX3 targets distinguish it from morphogen, NODAL-sequestration and FOXO/YAP neighbours.

name: Toll-like receptor and NLRP3 inflammasome inflammatory cytokine production
rationale: Members regulate TLR (mainly TLR2/4) and LPS signalling, NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasomes and IL-1/IL-6/TNF production; combining TLR sensing with NLRP inflammasomes separates it from pyroptosis/CASP4-5 and TRIF/CD40 neighbours.

name: Telomere maintenance by telomerase, recombination and end protection
rationale: Members cover telomerase recruitment and extension, recombination-based maintenance, C-strand replication, capping and replicative senescence; telomerase RNA Cajal-body trafficking and telomere specificity separate it from general DNA-repair and senescence neighbours.

core: Noncoding RNA modification and RNP biogenesis
name: Noncoding RNA methylation and snRNP/snoRNP biogenesis
rationale: Members methylate rRNA, tRNA and snRNA and assemble/traffic snRNPs and snoRNPs; snRNP assembly, cap hypermethylation and snRNA transport separate it from pseudouridylation and diphthamide neighbours.

name: GPCR-driven platelet activation and aggregation
rationale: Members cover platelet activation, degranulation, aggregation and coagulation via thrombin PAR, P2Y1/12, TP and prostacyclin receptors; these receptor routes separate it from collagen/GPIb adhesion and integrin/Rap1 neighbours.

name: p53-driven intrinsic apoptosis via NOXA and PUMA
rationale: Members are TP53 transcription of death genes and BH3-only NOXA/PUMA leading to cytochrome c release; these separate it from BAX/BAK/BAD and anoikis neighbours.

name: Motor coordination behavior and cerebellar cortex development
rationale: Members cover locomotion, motor learning, proprioception, righting and cerebellar/striatal development; the motor focus separates it from vocal/sensory behaviour neighbours and from the glial cerebellar-development neighbour.

name: RAF-MEK-ERK signalling, oncogenic mutants and negative feedback
rationale: Members cover RAF/MAP2K/MAPK activation, oncogenic RAS/RAF/MEK mutants and ERK inactivation by dephosphorylation and feedback; RAF mutants separate it from RAS-GAP neighbours and ERK feedback from SOS/RIT neighbours.
